ExplorePlaceCard
ExplorePlaceCard · Explore/ExplorePlaceCard.swift
The selected spot's identity, its light that day, and one primary action.
Save symbol
The Save control is a bookmark (bookmark / bookmark.fill), as everywhere else in the app.

Material
The card is regularMaterial in the app (canvas material/regular here); the snapshots draw it flat background/content. The built card is max 360 wide, centred at the bottom of the map with space/md margin.

textOverrides../Note Body/#text0: The scored card shows the Sample data label inline in the badge (showsSource defaults on); the passed-window card has none.
